overview: After 3.c4 White offers to change the centre, hoping for 3...dxc4 4.Bxc4 or quick development. Black can accept and White regains the pawn with Bxc4, or play 3...c6 and reach an exchange-style structure. White gets a lead in development and open lines at the cost of some structure. It is a rare sideline and I know it only roughly.

white_ideas.idea: Regain the c4 pawn with Bxc4
Develop quickly with Nc3, Nf3 and aim at Black's centre
Use the d4/e4 centre for space

black_ideas.idea: Take the pawn with ...dxc4 and develop ...Nf6

typical_structures.structure: Open centre after dxc4 and Bxc4 with White d4/e4
Possible isolated pawn if Black exchanges

character.notes: Mostly quiet; White's idea is development, not a long attack.

gambit.notes: The pawn comes back with Bxc4, so little material is given.

soundness.notes: Considered inferior; Black can equalise or better.

structure.notes: Centre opens after cxd5 or dxc4, but the structure is not fixed yet.

character.reason: Evidence is thin; the play seems mostly open but not forcing.

gambit.reason: The pawn is regained, though the line is named a gambit.

soundness.reason: Considered inferior to the main lines.

level.reason: Not beginner, as it is dubious.
